# Economy options

30 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `Economy`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AllowCrossTeamMail` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Whether players of opposite teams may mail each other (vmangos CONFIG_BOOL_ALLOW_TWO_SIDE_INTERACTION_MAIL). |
| `AllowCrossTeamTrade` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Whether players of opposite teams may trade (vmangos CONFIG_BOOL_ALLOW_TWO_SIDE_TRADE). |
| `AllowDeleteWithAttachments` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Letters with an item or money may be deleted by the receiver, destroying the attachment, as vmangos does (MailHandler.cpp:469-491 refuses only cash on delivery). Default false: only emptied letters can be deleted, the pre-lane behaviour, since no retail source shows attachments being destroyable. |
| `AuctionAccountConcurrentLimit` | `uint` | `0` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Active auctions one account may hold per auction house (vmangos Auction.AccountConcurrentLimit, World.cpp:538, AuctionHouseHandler.cpp:274-280). A listing counts from acceptance: while it settles, and while an unknown outcome is recovered. 0 = unlimited (default). |
| `AuctionDepositMin` | `uint` | `0` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Minimum deposit in copper (vmangos CONFIG_UINT32_AUCTION_DEPOSIT_MIN, default 0). |
| `AuctionHouses` | `List<AuctionHouseEntry>` | `[AuctionHouseEntry { Id = 2, DepositPercent = 5, CutPercent = 5 }, AuctionHouseEntry { Id = 6, DepositPercent = 5, CutPercent = 5 }, AuctionHouseEntry { Id = 7, DepositPercent = 25, CutPercent = 15 }]` | a list: numbered keys 0, 1, 2, ...; each entry is a group of keys | World | start | The three houses: Alliance 2, Horde 6, neutral (Blackwater/goblin) 7, with the deposit and cut percentages of the build-5875 client AuctionHouse.dbc (m_depositRate, m_consignmentRate), which vmangos reads: 5/5 for both faction houses, 25/15 for the neutral one. A configured entry is added after these three, whatever its index, and the last entry of an id is the one in force, so an entry with id 2, 6 or 7 replaces that house's percentages. |
| `AuctionRateCut` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Rate.Auction.Cut multiplier (vmangos World.cpp:536, default 1.0). |
| `AuctionRateDeposit` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Rate.Auction.Deposit multiplier (vmangos World.cpp:535, default 1.0). |
| `AuctionRateTime` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Rate.Auction.Time multiplier of a listing's duration (vmangos World.cpp:534, AuctionHouseHandler.cpp:362; default 1.0). |
| `AuctionSilentRefusals` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | A bid the bidder cannot afford, or a cancellation whose cut the seller cannot pay, is answered with nothing, as vmangos does (AuctionHouseHandler.cpp:498-503, 592-594); false answers NOT_ENOUGH_MONEY. Default true. |
| `CodExpireDays` | `uint` | `3` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Days before a cash-on-delivery letter expires (vmangos: 3). |
| `ExpirySweepSeconds` | `uint` | `60` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Seconds between expiry sweeps of mail and auctions. |
| `GmCrossTeamTrade` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Whether a game master with GM mode on may start a trade with a player of the other team although `AllowCrossTeamTrade` is off (default true). An ArcaneCore extension: vmangos HandleInitiateTradeOpcode (TradeHandler.cpp:634-636) has no such rule, so false is the retail behaviour. Only the initiator is tested; a player who invites a game master of the other team is refused. |
| `LetterItemEntry` | `uint` | `8383` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | The Plain Letter item created by CMSG_MAIL_CREATE_TEXT_ITEM (vmangos MAIL_BODY_ITEM_TEMPLATE 8383). |
| `MailBodyMaxLength` | `int` | `500` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Longest body in bytes; longer ones are dropped (vmangos MailHandler.cpp:158: 500). |
| `MailDeliveryDelaySeconds` | `uint` | `3600` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Delivery delay of letters carrying an item or money, seconds (vmangos MailDeliveryDelay, World.cpp:691: 1 hour). |
| `MailExpireDays` | `uint` | `30` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Days before an ordinary letter expires (vmangos: 30). |
| `MailMaxCodCopper` | `uint` | `100000000` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Largest cash-on-delivery amount accepted, copper (vmangos MailHandler.cpp:162: 100,000,000). |
| `MailOversizeAnswersError` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Answer oversize or over-COD letters with an internal error instead of dropping them silently like vmangos (default false). |
| `MailPostage` | `uint` | `30` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Postage per letter in copper (vmangos HandleSendMail: 30). |
| `MailReadExpiryDays` | `uint` | `3` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Reading a letter shortens its remaining life to this many days when more remains (vmangos MailHandler.cpp:454-458: 3; 0 disables). |
| `MailSubjectMaxLength` | `int` | `64` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Longest subject in bytes; longer ones are dropped (vmangos MailHandler.cpp:155: 64). |
| `MailboxAccess` | `MailboxAccessMode` | `Retail` | Retail \| Permissive | World | start | Mailbox proof for every mail opcode; `MailboxAccessMode.Retail` (default) or `MailboxAccessMode.Permissive` (config key `Economy:MailboxAccess`). Values: `Retail`, `Permissive`. |
| `MaxMailboxSize` | `int` | `100` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | A recipient already holding MORE than this many letters is refused (vmangos MailHandler.cpp:258: count &gt; 100). |
| `NeutralAuctioneerFactions` | `List<uint>` | `[21, 369, 577]` | a list: numbered keys 0, 1, 2, ...; each value is a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Faction.dbc ids of auctioneers that serve the neutral house (Booty Bay 21, Gadgetzan 369, Everlook 577: the factions of vmangos's goblin templates 120/474/855). |
| `ReturnExpiredMoneyOnlyMail` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Also return an expired money-only player letter to its sender (default true, the pre-lane behaviour; no retail source shows otherwise). false matches the emulators: vmangos and mangos-classic delete it (ObjectMgr.cpp:6995-7000: only letters with items are returned). |
| `SettlementBudgetSeconds` | `int` | `15` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Seconds one economy settlement (auction, mail, trade) may take end to end, and one economy store read, before it is abandoned: an operation that did not commit is answered with its ordinary failure reply (auction DATABASE error, mail INTERNAL_ERROR, trade cancelled), one whose outcome cannot be read kicks its actors. Operational, not a gameplay rule: 15 is the shipped value, three typical lock waits of the shipped 5 s Database:SqliteWriteTimeoutMs in a row (an unrelated character's write already in flight on the character save queue's one consumer, the actors' own saves, the settlement transaction), so one locked write ahead of it cannot use up the budget. A write-gate wait is not capped at one bound: it gives up after 5 s without a hand-off or 20 s of active waiting, but the settlement's budget token ends any wait it is passed to earlier. Valid range 1-300. |
| `TradeScamPreventionMs` | `uint` | `200` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Scam-prevention delay after a trade modification before an accept counts, ms (vmangos TradeHandler.cpp:657-658: 200; 0 = off). |
| `TradeScamPreventionWholeSeconds` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Measure the delay in whole seconds like vmangos (time(nullptr): effectively "not within the same second"); false uses real milliseconds (a true 200 ms). Default true. |
| `TradeSpaceNotifications` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Report not enough gold / bag space with notifications 801-803 and keep the window open, as vmangos does (TradeHandler.cpp:274-290, 420-455); false closes the trade with the inventory error. Default true. |
